description: This file defines the NotesService class, which provides CRUD operations for notes within an Angular application. It manages interactions with a backend API or falls back to an in-memory mock service if no API base URL is configured, handling environment variable resolution and API endpoint URL construction.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Provides CRUD operations for notes, fetching data either from a real API or a mock service based on environment configuration.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes, either from the mock service or via HTTP GET request to the backend API.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, either from the mock service or via HTTP GET request.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content, either through mock service or HTTP POST request.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID with provided payload, either via mock or HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, either through mock or HTTP DELETE request.

ctags.name: g
ctags.pattern: /^    const g: any = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : {};$/

ctags.name: hasProcess
ctags.pattern: /^    const hasProcess = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && typeof (globalThis as any).process !/
